stem: Which detail from the article “Cameras in the Courtroom” best supports the key idea in paragraphs 1 and 2 of the article “Challenging the Status Quo” that people are often reluctant to accept change?

options.label: A
options.text: Ban supporters believe that cameras would distract jurors during important courtroom proceedings.

options.label: B
options.text: Policymakers allowed the recording of federal civil proceedings in eight courtrooms.

options.label: C
options.text: A proposed bill could give judges the power to decide whether to allow media court recordings.

options.label: D
options.text: A recent report reveals that many federal judges have yet to be asked how they feel about cameras in courtrooms.
